personality_one_liner: A friendly, motivating, and approachable guide to finding your next career path, utilizing rounded shapes, energetic colors, and clear progression.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile spacing. Elements should feel like physical, touchable modules. Emphasize vertical rhythm and breathing room around nested cards.

do's: Use blur on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Use on the Floating Action Button (if any) or celebration modals.
Ensure readability by adding a tinted base under the blur.
dont's: Do not use on generic list rows, form fields, or standard buttons.
Do not overdo it. Maximum 2 glass surfaces per screen.

screens.name: Auth

states.loading: Spinner overlaid on the login button.
states.error: Inline text or toast showing authentication failure.

screens.layout: Simple column layout with a hero illustration at the top, clear inputs, and a prominent sticky CTA.

screens.name: OnboardingQuiz
screens.purpose: Multi-step questionnaire to capture current state, skills, likes/dislikes, and personality.

states.error: Error toast with a 'Try Again' button.

screens.layout: One question per screen. Use spectrum sliders, multi-select pill chips, and nested selection cards instead of long lists. Include a top progress bar, a back button, and a sticky 'Next' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: CareerMatches
screens.purpose: Show AI recommendations divided into two segments: 'What you can do now' and 'Requires new skills'.

states.empty: Illustration + 'We couldn't generate matches. Try updating your quiz answers.'
states.error: Error message with a retry CTA.

screens.layout: Top segmented control (Now vs. New Skills). List of chunky, touchable career cards. Each card displays title, short summary, and a match percentage badge.

screens.name: CareerDetail
screens.purpose: Provide in-depth information on a chosen career and a CTA to select this path.

states.loading: Skeleton for hero and text blocks.
states.error: Failed to load details. Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image with gradient scrim. Sections for Description, Pros (green check icons), Cons (red cross icons), and How to Start. Bottom sticky primary CTA 'Choose This Path' (triggers celebration sound/haptics).

screens.name: CareerRoadmap
screens.purpose: Visual winding road showing the user's progress toward the ultimate career goal.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Select a career path to see your roadmap.' + CTA to matches.

screens.layout: Vertical winding path (CSS/SVG or curved layout lines). Big milestones (positions/roles) shown as prominent nodes. Small checkpoints (tasks) between them with tappable checkboxes. Tapping a node opens a bottom sheet with step resources (links to YouTube, courses, etc.). Completed path segments should be distinct (solid line with brand color) from pending segments (dashed muted line).

screens.name: ProfileSettings
screens.purpose: Manage profile details and app preferences.
screens.layout: List layout. Includes a specific section for 'Theme Selection' allowing users to switch between 'Świeży' (Fresh), 'Spokojny' (Calm), and 'Ciemny' (Dark).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI utilizing the default 'Fresh' theme (Tactile / Playful LIGHT). Ensure you set up a ThemeProvider context to switch between the base 'color' (Fresh), 'theme_calm', and 'theme_dark'.
Theme Polish translations: 'Świeży i motywujący' (Fresh), 'Spokojny i profesjonalny' (Calm), 'Ciemny i nowoczesny' (Dark). Expose these inside the Profile/Settings screen.
The Onboarding Quiz must avoid long scrolling forms. Implement one question per screen with interactive inputs like multi-select chips and spectrum sliders. Include a progress bar at the top.

Implement the 'Winding Road' on the CareerRoadmap screen. Use an SVG-based curved path or staggered nodes to represent the journey. Differentiate completed paths visually (e.g., solid brand color line) from uncompleted (muted dashed line).

Big milestones on the road represent job positions. Small checkpoints represent tasks. Tapping a checkpoint must open a Bottom Sheet containing actionable links (YouTube, Urząd Pracy, study enrollments).
Crucial UX element: When the user selects a career path from CareerDetail, play a celebration sound (via expo-av) AND trigger a success haptic feedback. This marks a major emotional commitment.
Road specific colors (to be extracted from active theme): path_completed = brandPrimary, path_pending = muted/surfaceTertiary, milestone_unlocked = brandSecondary, milestone_current = brandPrimary.
